_comment: The failure catalog (docs/ROADMAP.md, slice 9a; src/systems/failures.gd). A failure is a part of a system that fails: 'system' is the runtime system's key (SimRuntime.SYSTEMS) and 'part' what its fail(part) takes. 'caution' is the caution and warning status light that comes on (CautionWarning.LIGHTS), with the trigger the CSM Apollo Operations Handbook, SM2A-03-BLOCK II-(1), pp. 2.10-5 to 2.10-8, gives it [published]; 'effect' what the system does then, as the simulator models it; 'expect' a Bus check that holds once it has (after 200 s at most); 'procedure' the malfunction procedure's title in data/malfunctions.json; 'event' the mission event it fires, and 'call' the crew's words to Houston, where it has them. A mission arms its failures at a GET in its mission.json ('failures': [{id, get_s}]), or a time after one of its events ([{id, event, after_s}], slice 9d); the instructor's page on the wrist menu fails any of them at once. The launch vehicle's failures (vehicle 'lv', slice 9d) light the main display console's launch vehicle lights ('lamp', its channel, and 'light') instead of a caution light; 'launch' is what the ground does about a failure in the launch: 'abort' ends it in the abort mode the flight is in, 'return' brings the crew home at once (mode III rather than IV). The LM's failures (vehicle 'lm', slice 9e) light the LM's caution and warning lights (LmCautionWarning.LIGHTS), with the triggers of the LM Apollo Operations Handbook, LMA790-3-LM, section 2.9.4 [published], and open their procedures in data/lm_malfunctions.json, in the LM's checklist book.

failures.title: Cryogenic oxygen tank 2
failures.effect: The tank vents in about three minutes; the shared valve module starves fuel cells 1 and 3, and tank 1 leaks away over 2 h 20 min
failures.procedure: Malfunction: CRYO PRESS
failures.call: Houston, we've had a problem. Main B bus undervolt; O2 tank 2 pressure reading zero.
failures._comment: Apollo 13's, at 55:54:53 (MSC-02680, Table 3-I) [published]: Eps.fail_o2_tank(2) [derived, the class's comment]. CRYO PRESS lights with an O2 tank below 800 psia. In the launch the ground brings the crew home at once, rather than into orbit ('launch': 'return', mode III late in the launch) [estimated: the flight rules aren't at hand]

failures.title: Fuel cell 1
failures.effect: The cell stops making power; the other two carry the load
failures.procedure: Malfunction: FC 1, 2 or 3
failures._comment: FC 1 lights for a fuel cell's flow, temperature or pH out of limits [published]; the failure is the cell's [simplified: its output at once to nothing]

failures.title: Fuel cell 2
failures.effect: The cell stops making power; the other two carry the load
failures.procedure: Malfunction: FC 1, 2 or 3

failures.title: Fuel cell 3
failures.effect: The cell stops making power; the other two carry the load
failures.procedure: Malfunction: FC 1, 2 or 3

failures.title: SM RCS quad A
failures.effect: The quad's helium fails, its propellant pressure falls and its jets stop: pitch and Z translation on quad C alone
failures.procedure: Malfunction: SM RCS A, B, C or D
failures._comment: SM RCS A lights with the quad's secondary fuel pressure below 145 psia [published]; the failure is its helium's [simplified: the pressure and the jets gone at once]

failures.title: SM RCS quad B
failures.effect: The quad's helium fails, its propellant pressure falls and its jets stop: yaw and Y translation on quad D alone
failures.procedure: Malfunction: SM RCS A, B, C or D

failures.title: SM RCS quad C
failures.effect: The quad's helium fails, its propellant pressure falls and its jets stop: pitch and Z translation on quad A alone
failures.procedure: Malfunction: SM RCS A, B, C or D

failures.title: SM RCS quad D
failures.effect: The quad's helium fails, its propellant pressure falls and its jets stop: yaw and Y translation on quad B alone
failures.procedure: Malfunction: SM RCS A, B, C or D

failures.title: The CMC
failures.effect: The computer stops: its DSKY goes dark, its autopilot and programs stop, and its IMU is caged
failures.procedure: Malfunction: CMC
failures._comment: CMC lights for a loss of the CMC's prime power, among others [published]; the failure is the power's [simplified: for good, the IMU caged with it as a power-down cages it]

failures.title: The IMU
failures.effect: The platform fails and is caged: NO ATT on the DSKY, and no coarse align, P51 or P52 brings it back
failures.procedure: Malfunction: ISS
failures._comment: ISS lights for an IMU failure, a gimbal's servo error over 2.9 mr for 2 s among them [published]

failures.title: S-IC engine 1
failures.effect: The F-1 shuts down: its LV ENG light comes on and the S-IC burns on the others. With a second out the EDS aborts
failures.procedure: Malfunction: LV ENG, LV RATE or LV GUID
failures._comment: Slice 9d's launch vehicle failures have no caution and warning light but the main display console's launch vehicle lights (lamp, light) [published: CSM Apollo Operations Handbook, section 2.9.4.5.2]; 'launch' says the ground ends the launch for them (MissionSequencer's aborts). S-IC engines 1 and 2 stand for any two of its five [simplified]: the vehicle flies on with one out, and both out is the EDS's two-engines-out abort

failures.title: S-IC engine 2
failures.effect: The F-1 shuts down: its LV ENG light comes on and the S-IC burns on the others. With a second out the EDS aborts
failures.procedure: Malfunction: LV ENG, LV RATE or LV GUID

failures.title: The IU's guidance platform
failures.effect: The IU loses its attitude reference and turns the vehicle away: LV GUID, and LV RATE through the S-IC's flight, where the EDS aborts on the rates
failures.procedure: Malfunction: LV ENG, LV RATE or LV GUID
failures._comment: LV GUID lights for the IU's platform's loss of attitude reference, with LV RATE through the first stage's boost (section 2.9.4.5.2) [published]

failures.title: The S-II's engines
failures.effect: All five J-2s shut down: the stack coasts on its S-II short of orbit until the crew aborts
failures.procedure: Malfunction: LV ENG, LV RATE or LV GUID

failures.title: The S-IVB's engine
failures.effect: The J-2 shuts down short of orbit: mode IV takes the CSM on into orbit on the SPS
failures.procedure: Malfunction: LV ENG, LV RATE or LV GUID
failures._comment: Apollo 11's alternate mission 1: the S-IVB failing before insertion, the CSM's contingency orbit insertion on the SPS (press kit) [published]

failures.title: The descent engine's helium regulator
failures.effect: The regulator fails closed: the descent tanks' pressure falls as the engine burns, and its thrust dies away with it; in the descent the crew abort stage
failures.procedure: Malfunction: DES REG
failures._comment: DES REG lights for the helium downstream of the regulators below 219.2 or above 259.1 psia, before staging, once the descent engine has first been armed [published]; the pressure's fall and the thrust's [estimated] (spacecraft.json "dps")

failures.title: LM RCS system A's regulator
failures.effect: System A's helium pressure goes out of limits and its jets stop: the LM flies on system B's; closing A's main shutoff valves puts the light out
failures.procedure: Malfunction: RCS A or B REG
failures._comment: RCS A REG lights for system A's helium above 218.8 or below 164.4 psia, and goes out when its main shutoff valves close [published]; the jets stop at once [simplified]

failures.title: LM RCS system B's regulator
failures.effect: System B's helium pressure goes out of limits and its jets stop: the LM flies on system A's; closing B's main shutoff valves puts the light out
failures.procedure: Malfunction: RCS A or B REG

failures.title: The LGC
failures.effect: The computer stops: its DSKY goes dark and its autopilot and programs stop; with GUID CONT at AGS the AGS holds the LM and the light goes out
failures.procedure: Malfunction: LGC or ISS
failures._comment: LGC lights for the LGC's power failure among others, unless GUID CONT is at AGS [published]

failures.title: The LM's IMU
failures.effect: The LGC's platform fails and is caged: NO ATT on the DSKY; with GUID CONT at AGS the AGS holds the LM and the light goes out
failures.procedure: Malfunction: LGC or ISS
failures._comment: ISS lights for a failure in the inertial subsystem, unless GUID CONT is at AGS [published]
